final: WITH g AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.translink, g.cnt, 1.0*g.cnt/t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_group_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
